requests: The clause 14.9 conditions for moving up a stage early (competency proportion, apprenticeship authority and training package requirements, then agreement or RTO written advice) would read better as an <ol> than as a paragraph.

The opening could name the financial year (2026-27) and the 4-year, post-1 January 2014 scope. Those figures are only in the H1 and the methodology, and this pass may not add or move numbers. Please add an expression or constant (for example a FY label) the opening can use.

(applies to /apprentice-pay/{trade}/ FAQ 'How much does a fourth-year apprentice X earn?') The fourth-year FAQ answers open with 'The minimum in fourth year is...' and do not name the trade, because the answer string holds no ${label} expression and this pass cannot add one. Add ${label} to these answers so the trade is the subject (e.g. 'The minimum for a fourth-year apprentice ${label} is...').

(applies to /apprentice-pay/{trade}/ FAQ 'When does an apprentice X's pay go up?') The answer cannot name the trade either, since it has no ${label} expression. It now opens 'Apprentice pay goes up...'. Adding ${label} would let it read 'An apprentice ${label}'s pay goes up...'.
